comment: The one table of HAMH_TOOLS_MODE words. infra/test/tools-mode.test.ts runs it through resolveToolsMode (lib/config.ts) and scripts/tests/test_deploy_direct.py runs it through resolve_tools_mode (scripts/lib/deploy.py), so the two parsers cannot drift apart. A setting of null is a variable that is not set. Only the six ASCII whitespace characters (space, tab, line feed, carriage return, form feed, vertical tab) are trimmed: Python's strip() and JavaScript's trim() differ on U+001C to U+001F, U+0085 and U+FEFF, so neither resolver uses them.
